checklist.label: What happened
checklist.why: Your own account, in date order.

checklist.label: Your name and full address
checklist.why: Goes on the claim form, so it needs the block, unit number and postal code.

checklist.label: Who you are claiming against, and their full address
checklist.why: The tribunal needs their full Singapore address, with postal code, so the claim can be served.

checklist.label: What kind of claim it is
checklist.why: The tribunal only hears some kinds: goods, services, home leases up to 2 years, damage to property.

checklist.label: What was agreed
checklist.why: The agreement, order or quote sets the terms.

checklist.label: How much you are claiming
checklist.why: The limit is $20,000, or $30,000 if both sides agree.

checklist.label: When they refused, or the problem started
checklist.why: You have 2 years from that date to file.

checklist.label: Your files
checklist.why: Only files count as evidence. Add them on the right.
